phase_name: Commit a Source-Store Path in Its Own Repository

objectives.description: Wire into git-commit-phase.sh, fail-open, outcome-aware notice

approaches_tried.description: Initial source_store_classify attribution emitted the path relative to source_dir (stripping the source_rel/ prefix) rather than relative to source_toplevel
approaches_tried.reason: The documented contract is path_relative_to_that_toplevel (the repository root), not relative to source_dir; the wrong field made the Phase 4 end-to-end landing test fail with 'file does not exist' because commit-source-store-path.sh received a path one level too short to resolve on disk. Fixed in scripts/lib/source-store-path-lib.sh (part of this phase's own files_touched, since the fix was discovered while verifying Phase 4's end-to-end case) and in test-source-store-path-lib.sh's Case 1/2 assertions.
